init_voxelcounter_with_block_data: create a VoxelCounter with memory and block_data dicts to count matching voxels
call_voxelcounter_on_mems: run VoxelCounter on a list of memory objects to get voxel counts per object
count_blockobject_voxels: count voxels in BlockObject nodes by filtering against allowed block type triples
count_instseg_voxels: count voxels in InstSeg nodes by checking triple object tags match desired properties
repr_voxelcounter: get a string representation of VoxelCounter showing its block_data configuration
